gettingStarted.label: Getting started
gettingStarted.helpText: Check-In Crew runs monthly accountability and community engagement threads, alongside simple recurring posts. Customise templates and individual upcoming posts while keeping automatic scheduled publishing. Assign volunteer hosts and give trusted community members access to manage their series. Open the subreddit menu → Open Check-In Crew dashboard → Open dashboard to create series, manage hosts, and edit upcoming posts.

general.label: General
general.helpText: Shared options for all series. Pause or resume automatic posting from the dashboard.

maxSeries.label: Maximum series
maxSeries.helpText: Maximum current series in this community (1–60; default 10). Paused series count; archived series do not. Higher limits can slow the dashboard and increase scheduled posting work, especially with hourly schedules or large preview windows. Lowering the limit does not remove or pause existing series; creation and restoration require a free slot.

allowManualPosting.label: Allow Post now (testing or early publishing)
allowManualPosting.helpText: Shows Post now beside unposted topics. It creates a real post immediately, even while paused, and prevents the scheduler from posting that topic again. Turning this off hides Post now; automatic posting continues.

showCrewFooter.label: Show app footer
showCrewFooter.helpText: Adds “Scheduled with Check-In Crew.” at the end of posts.

defaultCommunityNote.label: Default community note
defaultCommunityNote.helpText: Inserted wherever a post body includes {community_note}. Edit this message for your community, or leave it blank to omit it. The current message is filled in when a post is published.
defaultCommunityNote.defaultValue: Be kind to yourself and each other. Participation is voluntary; share only what you feel comfortable sharing.

allowHourlySchedules.label: Allow hourly schedules
allowHourlySchedules.helpText: Allows Other schedules to repeat every 1–120 hours. Leave off unless the community has a clear event-based use for frequent posts. Hourly schedules remain subject to Reddit's spam rules.

monthly.label: Monthly series
monthly.helpText: A start post, daily check-ins, and a finish post each calendar month. Changes apply to upcoming posts using these defaults. Customised series and individual posts keep their overrides.

defaultMonthlyHostCredit.label: Default host credit
defaultMonthlyHostCredit.helpText: Used by {host_credit_monthly} in monthly templates. Use {hosts} for usernames, {series} for the display name, and {month} for the month and year. A custom monthly-series format overrides this.

defaultSignupTemplate.label: Start (signup) — default post body

defaultDailyTemplate.label: Daily check-in — default post body

defaultRoundupTitle.label: Finish (wrap-up) — default title
defaultRoundupTitle.defaultValue: 30 Day Accountability Challenge — {series} — Day {day} {month} Wrap Ups

defaultRoundupTemplate.label: Finish (wrap-up) — default post body

simple.label: Simple recurring posts
simple.helpText: One post template repeated daily, weekly, or on a custom Other schedule. Changes apply to upcoming posts using these defaults. Customised series and individual posts keep their overrides.

defaultSimpleDailyTitle.label: Daily — default title
defaultSimpleDailyTitle.helpText: Shortcodes: {series} (display name), {weekday} (Monday), {day} (day number), {date} (YYYY-MM-DD), {month} (month and year). Also supports {frequency} (Daily or Weekly).

defaultSimpleWeeklyTitle.label: Weekly — default title
defaultSimpleWeeklyTitle.helpText: Shortcodes: {series} (display name), {weekday} (Monday), {day} (day number), {date} (YYYY-MM-DD), {month} (month and year). Also supports {frequency} (Daily or Weekly).

defaultSimpleOtherTitle.label: Other — default title
defaultSimpleOtherTitle.helpText: Default title for custom repeat schedules. Supports {series}, {weekday}, {day}, {date}, {time}, {month} and {frequency}.

defaultSimpleTemplate.label: Default post body
defaultSimpleTemplate.helpText: Supports title shortcodes plus {frequency} (Daily, Weekly or Recurring), {host_credit_simple}, {community_note} and {previous_link}.
defaultSimpleTemplate.defaultValue:
Share an update, a question, or something you are working on.

{community_note}

defaultSimpleHostCredit.label: Default host credit when included
defaultSimpleHostCredit.helpText: Used by {host_credit_simple}. Simple series hide host credits by default; this format is used only when a series enables Include host credit. Use {hosts}, {series}, and {month}.

dailyPostsAhead.label: Daily posts shown ahead
dailyPostsAhead.helpText: Upcoming posts shown for each daily series (1–60; initially 15). The window rolls forward across months. It does not limit automatic posting or remove saved edits.

weeklyPostsAhead.label: Weekly posts shown ahead
weeklyPostsAhead.helpText: Upcoming posts shown for each weekly series (1–60; initially 5). The window rolls forward across months. It does not limit automatic posting or remove saved edits.

otherPostsAhead.label: Other posts shown ahead
otherPostsAhead.helpText: Upcoming posts shown for each Other schedule (1–60; initially 5). This only changes the dashboard window, not automatic posting or saved edits.

dangerZone.label: Danger zone
dangerZone.helpText: Deletion is permanent and intended for exceptional cases. Archiving is the normal way to retire a series. Deleting posts does not delete their comments.

allowMaintainerDeletion.label: Allow maintainers to delete individual posts
allowMaintainerDeletion.helpText: Off by default. When enabled, assigned maintainers can permanently delete posts created by this app in their own series, after typing DELETE. Moderators always have access. Bulk deletion remains moderator-only.

bulkDeleteCooldownDays.label: Bulk post deletion cooldown (days)
bulkDeleteCooldownDays.helpText: 1–30 days; default 7, minimum 24 hours. Applies only when a moderator explicitly chooses to delete a series AND its published posts. Cancellation is available before the deadline. Changing this setting does not alter existing countdowns.

communityTools.label: Community tools
communityTools.helpText: Optional tools available to visitors without management access.

enableCommunityCalculator.label: Enable calorie needs and BMI calculator
enableCommunityCalculator.helpText: Shows an adult maintenance-calorie estimate and neutral BMI number in the public view. Measurements and results stay in memory on the device; they are not sent to the app server or saved. Off by default for communities that do not need weight-related tools.

communityCalculatorModeratorsOnly.label: Limit post calculator to moderators
communityCalculatorModeratorsOnly.helpText: Only moderators can open the calculator from a post or comment unless you explicitly turn this off. The calculator remains available in the public view when enabled. Existing installations remain moderator-only until this setting is explicitly turned off.

enableUserFlair.label: Enable Set flair
enableUserFlair.helpText: Lets signed-in members preview and apply their own public flair using the formats below. Separate from the calculator; no calculator inputs are copied. It cannot operate while user flair is disabled in Reddit’s community settings.

allowBotFlairAssignment.label: Allow Set flair when Reddit self-assignment is off
allowBotFlairAssignment.helpText: Off by default. Enable only if this community intentionally wants members to receive flair through Check-In Crew while Reddit’s normal ‘allow users to assign and edit’ setting is off. This cannot override Reddit’s separate ‘enable user flair’ setting, and moderator-only templates are never used.

allowReplacingExistingFlair.label: Allow Set flair to replace existing flair
allowReplacingExistingFlair.helpText: Off by default. Check-In Crew protects all existing flair because Reddit’s public API does not identify the current flair template. Enable only if moderators have confirmed that replacing members’ existing flair is appropriate. Moderator-only flair with the same exact template text remains protected.

flairBehaviour.label: User flair — Reddit template
flairBehaviour.helpText: Formats below control the wording. The Reddit template controls appearance. Changes apply only when a member explicitly selects Apply. When self-assignment is enabled in Reddit, choose a member-editable template; when bot assignment is enabled above, a non-moderator text template can be used.

userFlairTemplate.label: Reddit user flair template ID (optional)
userFlairTemplate.helpText: Leave blank to use the first suitable non-moderator text template. Otherwise paste its ID from Reddit user flair settings. Moderator-only and emoji-only templates cannot be used.

flairFormat1.label: Flair format 1
flairFormat1.helpText: Default example: 35F | 165cm | SW:90kg CW:75kg GW:65kg. Use {flair1}–{flair8} to insert the fields above. Weight/height include units. Optional empty fields and attached labels such as SW: are omitted. Final flair must fit 64 characters.

flairFormat2.label: Flair format 2
flairFormat2.helpText: Default example: SW:90kg | CW:75kg | GW:65kg. Use {flair1}–{flair8} to insert the fields above. Weight/height include units. Optional empty fields and attached labels such as SW: are omitted. Final flair must fit 64 characters.

flairFormat3.label: Flair format 3
flairFormat3.helpText: Default example: 90kg → 75kg. Use {flair1}–{flair8} to insert the fields above. Weight/height include units. Optional empty fields and attached labels such as SW: are omitted. Final flair must fit 64 characters.

flairFormat4.label: Flair format 4
flairFormat4.helpText: Default example: 75kg → 65kg. Use {flair1}–{flair8} to insert the fields above. Weight/height include units. Optional empty fields and attached labels such as SW: are omitted. Final flair must fit 64 characters.
